label: `always` is offered by the terminal overlay and accepted by `bots answer`, but no listing, revocation, expiry or audit contract exists; the label promises persistence the build does not provide and the future rule store inherits grants with no lifecycle. Remove `always` until the store lands, or require `bots grants list|revoke`, a 30-day default expiry, bot+kind scope and an audit row.

`conversation` is an unrepresentable scope: the item has no conversation id and the terminal screen never offers it. Add a conversationId to the grant or drop the scope until phase 010/011 supplies one.
Rung 2 (`rule`) can never fire because no rule store exists; mark it not implemented in the ladder doc and the decideApproval comment so the precedence order is not misleading.

The answered-action audit trail is missing: the grant lives only on the item, so expiry or deletion erases it. Append one grant row per answer to grants.jsonl with item, bot, kind, scope, actor and timestamp.
